functionDescriptions: Facilitative hexose transporter that mediates the transport of glucose, fructose and galactose (PubMed:16186102, PubMed:23396969, PubMed:28083649, PubMed:8027028, PubMed:8457197). Likely mediates the bidirectional transfer of glucose across the plasma membrane of hepatocytes and is responsible for uptake of glucose by the beta cells; may comprise part of the glucose-sensing mechanism of beta cells (PubMed:8027028). May also participate with the Na(+)/glucose cotransporter in the transcellular transport of glucose in the small intestine and kidney (PubMed:3399500). Also able to mediate the transport of dehydroascorbate and urate (PubMed:23396969, PubMed:40209957). {ECO:0000269|PubMed:16186102, ECO:0000269|PubMed:23396969, ECO:0000269|PubMed:28083649, ECO:0000269|PubMed:3399500, ECO:0000269|PubMed:40209957, ECO:0000269|PubMed:8027028, ECO:0000269|PubMed:8457197}.
